mathematics.assertion_tested: For an isotropic self-gravitating Burkert profile with zero outer pressure, compute P0/(G Sigma^2) by two quadratures. Test a dimensionless determinant-of-kinetic-stress diagnostic on four explicit stream sets and finite boosts/rotations.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: real-valued functions approximated by double precision
mathematics.conventions: Sigma=rho0*r0; M=pi*rho0*r0^3*B(r/r0); kinetic pressure is mass-density times velocity covariance; no collisional pressure assumed
inputs: four explicit equal-weight stream sets in check_stress.py
non_claims: Does not derive a dynamical core mechanism, action, floor coefficient or RAR
Does not assert the diagnostic remains off with finite primordial velocity dispersion
Does not identify kinetic moments with a microscopic field stress
